messages.subject: Outputting Data
parts:
This may be a more general R question but I am working on getting all my data from methylKit functions into files. Specifically the output from the functions mentioned at the end of the users guide:

as(meth, "GRanges") and as(myDiff, "GRanges")


I tried saving these as objects and printing them out as such:


Granges_meth <- as(meth, "GRanges")

write.table(Granges_meth, file="Granges_meth.txt", quote=FALSE)


but from this I get error :  Error in as.vector(x) : no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector


is there an easy way to output this data to a file that I am missing?


Thanks in advance,

    ​Micah

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Outputting Data
parts:
you should use getData() on methylKit objects to convert them to data frame, then you can use write.table() 

In general, I don't think you can not write out GRanges objects as text files w/o converting them to data frame first.

Best,
Altuna
